```sh
kafka token create
```

Create a delegation token

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Token HMAC is redacted unless --show-secrets is supplied. Lifetime bounds are broker-dependent.

## Before you run

Creates bearer credentials. --show-secrets exposes the HMAC; keep it out of logs and screenshots and store it securely.

## Flags

| Flag                              | Description                                                                 |
| --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`              | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092                            |
| `--owner <string>`                | owning principal, "PrincipalType:name" (defaults to the authenticated user) |
| `--renewer <string> (repeatable)` | a principal allowed to renew the token, "PrincipalType:name" (repeatable)   |
| `--max-life-time-ms <string>`     | maximum token lifetime in ms (defaults to the broker setting)               |
| `--show-secrets`                  | print the token hmac instead of redacting it                                |

## Examples

```sh
kafka token create --renewer User:alice --brokers localhost:9092 --show-secrets
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "tokenId": "example-token",
  "hmac": "[REDACTED]"
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
